input.summary: Collect three locks at the Jump Shot, complete the multiball's ramp, orbit, and Jump Shot waves, then collect the captive-ball Super and timed Super Duper.

quickInfo.name: Locks
quickInfo.summary: The Jump Shot lights and collects locks; three locks start the main multiball.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot waves
quickInfo.summary: The first wave uses ramps, the second uses both orbits and the Jump Shot, and the third lights the captive-ball Super.

quickInfo.name: Super Duper
quickInfo.summary: After the Super, the right ramp briefly lights the captive ball for the larger award.

quickInfo.name: Seven planets
quickInfo.summary: SLAM, In Yer Face, FIRE, SPACE JAM, Rebound, Fast Break, and a multiball Super qualify Final Jam.

quickInfo.name: Modes and Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Only one mode runs at a time. Starting the main Multiball pauses a running mode until Multiball ends.

quickInfo.name: Final Jam
quickInfo.summary: The left ramp starts five-ball Final Jam; switches build the basket collect.

steps.text: Test the Jump Shot eject, both ramps, both orbits, and captive-ball rebound before qualifying locks.
Shoot the Jump Shot to light and collect three locks; later multiballs require additional qualification shots.
At multiball start, collect the easier lit ramp from control, then take any remaining ramp required by the current wave.
Follow the displayed wave instead of repeating an unlit shot.
modeNotes: Opening wave: lit ramp jackpot or jackpots.
Second wave: left orbit, right orbit, and Jump Shot.
Fourth wave: right ramp to light the timed captive-ball Super Duper.

steps.text: After the Super, shoot the right ramp only when the following captive-ball hit is available inside its timer.
Between multiballs, finish the safest missing planet requirements while keeping the lock lane as the default route.
When all seven planets are lit, shoot the left ramp to start Final Jam and repeat controlled basket feeds.

fallback.title: Fast Break ramp scoring
fallback.when: Use this when the Jump Shot rejects but both orbit feeds and the right ramp are controlled.

steps.text: Complete the required left- and right-orbit shots.
Start Fast Break.
Repeat the right ramp while its increasing value and return remain safe.

alternatives.title: Planet progress
alternatives.when: Use this when several planet requirements are already close through incidental play.

steps.text: Complete the safest of SLAM, FIRE, Rebound, or SPACE JAM.
Use multiball to secure its Super planet.
Return to locks unless Final Jam is within one controlled requirement.

alternatives.title: Wabbit Hole award
alternatives.when: Use this when the two 23 targets are already nearly complete.

steps.text: Finish the 23 targets without forcing a dangerous rebound.
Collect the stacked Wabbit Hole award.
Use any awarded multiball or frenzy as protection, not as a replacement for the main route.
Complete all seven planet objectives to light their inserts.
Include the captive-ball Super from the main multiball.
Shoot the left ramp to start Final Jam.
Build value through safe switches and collect it at the basket.

playfieldReferences.description: Lane used to light and collect multiball locks and a second-wave jackpot.
playfieldReferences.context: Jump Shot: Lane used to light and collect multiball locks and a second-wave jackpot.

playfieldReferences.label: Basket ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Left ramp used for basket scoring, jackpots, and Final Jam start.
playfieldReferences.context: left ramp: Left ramp used for basket scoring, jackpots, and Final Jam start.

playfieldReferences.label: FIRE ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Right ramp used for FIRE, jackpots, Fast Break, and Super Duper qualification.
playfieldReferences.context: right ramp: Right ramp used for FIRE, jackpots, Fast Break, and Super Duper qualification.

playfieldReferences.label: Super target
playfieldReferences.description: Captive ball used for In Yer Face, Super Jackpot, and Super Duper.
playfieldReferences.context: captive ball: Captive ball used for In Yer Face, Super Jackpot, and Super Duper.

playfieldReferences.label: Orbit jackpots
playfieldReferences.description: Left and right orbits used for Fast Break and the second multiball wave.
playfieldReferences.context: orbits: Left and right orbits used for Fast Break and the second multiball wave.

techniques.name: Wave reading
techniques.instruction: Check which shots are lit after every collect; each multiball wave changes the required route.

techniques.name: Super Duper setup
techniques.instruction: Shoot the right ramp only when a controlled ball can reach the captive ball during the brief collect window.

cautions.issue: The Jump Shot VUK can return the ball at very different speeds.
cautions.response: Observe its first eject before attempting a one-timed follow-up shot.

cautions.issue: Modes and the ball save end without a grace period.
cautions.response: Start timed scoring only with an immediate feed and do not assume a late trough switch will be rescued.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Sega Space Jam ROM, lock difficulty, ball save, mode timers, and award conversions.
Test the Jump Shot, captive ball, both ramps, both orbits, and basket feeds.
input.simpleOverview: Three Jump Shot locks start Space Jam's Multiball, which moves through ramp, orbit, Jump Shot, and captive-ball waves. Follow the currently lit wave, collect Super at the captive ball, and attempt the timed right-ramp-to-captive-ball Super Duper only from a controlled feed.
input.overview: Three Jump Shot locks start Space Jam's Multiball, which moves through ramp, orbit, Jump Shot, and captive-ball waves. Prioritize Jump Shot locks and clear each displayed Jackpot wave in order, finishing with the captive-ball Super and a controlled Super Duper attempt. Between starts, complete the safest missing planet, remembering that main Multiball pauses rather than stacks with a running mode.
